content.contents: an unsettling, kind of weird, perhaps 'cursed' image. edited in photoshop, but... what is it actually a picture of?
this was my dog when i was younger, his name was pippin. he was a real sweetheart. i'm not really sure if he's still kickin, but hopefully he's out there somewhere playing and having fun!
